summary_1line: A sage repeatedly transforms his loyal dog into stronger beasts to protect it, until the empowered creature grows predatory and eventually turns against the sage.

image_candidates.scene_text: A humble dog beside a forest sage suddenly transforms into a golden-striped leopard as the sage raises his hand in blessing.
The transformed beast stands as a massive eight-legged Sarabha before the hermitage while terrified forest animals flee into the trees.
The monstrous Sarabha, once a dog, crouches with bloodthirsty intent toward the meditating sage who calmly perceives the betrayal.
